purpose: decision.2026-10-20.account-mixed-tiers says: reverse (rerun the Sonnet lanes on Opus) if the synthesis finds the Sonnet lanes' claims materially weaker or wrong. This file records the re-check.
method: For each Sonnet lane, the synthesis picked the claims it relies on for a decision (defaults, validation, versioning, India handling, billing, access) and re-read the saved raw artifact under data/account-phase/<lane>/ with python3 -I (field lookups only, no key, no network). Bolna (Opus lane) was checked the same way, including a trace of the audio gate in the open-source code. Verdicts: confirmed | confirmed-partly (artifact supports the claim but part of it is not on disk) | contradicted.

other_quality_findings: 6 Sarvam claims graded observed rest only on vendor docs pages (SAC-20, SAC-22, SAC-29, SAC-45, SAC-47, SAC-49); the synthesis reads them as vendor-claimed.

The Retell lane's report text cites claim ids that are shifted against its claims.json in sections 1, 2, 5 and 6 (e.g. report RAP-35 = claims RAP-34 on Indian numbers; report RAP-43 = claims RAP-40 on live control; report RAP-33 = claims RAP-31 on platform voices). claims.json ids are authoritative.
All 282 lane claims carry evidence, and every cited local path exists on disk (checked 2026-10-20).
summary.verdict: Not materially weaker or wrong. The reversal condition of decision.2026-10-20.account-mixed-tiers is not met; no Sonnet lane needs a rerun on Opus for what this phase could reach. The difference between lanes is access (Bolna had source code; Sarvam's key class was refused), not model tier.
